scope: Multi-particle wall reductions, simultaneous grain/plane histories, memory inventory and complete serial regression of the fixed-normal wall laboratory

gates.multiwall_reduction: 257 bodies, two planes and two reduction levels: exact integer active counts per plane and in total; force and origin moment errors <1e-4 of independently summed force and force*0.04m scales
gates.mixed_history: Active grain pair and wall contacts coexist with unique stable source keys and nonzero continuing springs for both target types
gates.multi_body_work: Total and per-wall work agreement <1e-5 current elastic-energy proxy
gates.force_moment_balance: All grain forces/moments plus wall reactions balance within 1e-5 force and force*0.006m scales
gates.memory_inventory: Logical device-buffer byte count exactly equals independent traversal over every owned Slang buffer, including reduction trees and backup state
gates.regression: Complete serial actual-Metal pytest suite, with no relaxed existing assertions

limitations: No published benchmark or material acceptance
